title: TypeScript Utility Types
description: Master Partial, Pick, Omit, Record, and other utility types for type transformations.

data.text: TypeScript provides utility types for common type transformations: Partial makes all properties optional, Pick selects properties, Omit removes properties, and more.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Record<K, T> creates object type from keys
data.takeaway: Utility types provide powerful type transformations without manual definition. Use them to derive types from existing types declaratively.
